name: frame-lab
description: Compare Minecraft frame captures, catch invalid measurements, and inspect a supported local benchmark setup. See frame-time tails and true 1% lows alongside the settings that produced them. Live capture requires a supported macOS Minecraft installation; saved evidence can be analyzed in an execution-capable environment.
